title: Charge sheet
description: A case put to the Tribunal. Meaning of each field is specified in docs/02-charge-sheet-spec.md; this file is the enforceable form of that document. Word-count bounds on `background` and uniqueness of `case_id` are checked by G1 in code, not here.

case_id.description: Assigned identifier. Never derived from the title.

fictional.description: Every case this term is a fictional proceeding. Pinned so a non-fictional case cannot be added without an explicit schema change.

act_alleged.description: One act, stated as fact, without characterisation.

background.description: 200-400 words for a reader who does not know the story. Narrative, not argument. Exact word bounds enforced by G1.

agreed_facts.description: Propositions both seats accept. ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT AND STABLE: opinions cite these by index. Never reorder or delete an entry once a case has been deliberated; a correction appends.

issue.description: The exact question for judgment. Answerable as justified or not_justified and no other way.

imposes_sentence.description: The Tribunal decides justified / not justified and gives reasons. It does not sentence.

combines_opinions.description: The three opinions are reported side by side and are never combined. Pinned false; a case cannot opt out.

representatives.description: Exactly four. Exactly two per seat - the 2/2 balance is checked by G1. The seat fixes the procedural role only; it does not fix an opinion, an inference, or a final position.
